title: NextGI Perf with its 4 skinned characters, hardware ray tracing, Medium (Lite) (GS-7)

lines.name: Lite total on hardware ray tracing (Medium, irradiance field gather)
lines.reason: Provisional groups, as GS-9's on the kitbash set: the GodotNext group is the NextGI frame block (nextgi_* without the closing marker's column and line 1b), and the UE group is the three stat gpu passes the settings record names for the Lumen total, which leave out the Lumen scene update columns the captures also report. Which columns both totals take waits for the lead and the settings record (plan §23.5). At Medium UE runs Lumen Lite: the game-mode captures on the RTX 4080 SUPER show GPU/LumenIrradianceFieldGather, while GPU/LumenScreenProbeGather and GPU/LumenReflections stay at 0 (sg.ReflectionQuality 1 turns Lumen reflections off and GPU/ScreenSpaceReflections appears), so the UE group is the scene lighting and the irradiance field gather. On 244 of the path's 600 rows GodotNext's 80 m far plane clips geometry inside the view (the courtyard's far end) that the UE port draws and lights, because the UE import sets only the camera's near plane (the export's camera_far approximation): the lead decides on this difference, as on the loop wrap, before the line is judged. UE takes the hardware tier from r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing 1 at launch, because the shared comparison project keeps Use Hardware Ray Tracing when available off. This departs from the settings record and plan §23.5, which say the comparison enables the two project settings, until the lead decides.
